scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n nova,runtime,edge -c blue,magenta,green "VITE_EDGE_ORIGIN=http://localhost:8787 npm run dev --workspace @rocketcrab/nova" "npm run dev --workspace @rocketcrab/runtime" "npm run edge:dev -- --port 8787"
scripts.dev:https: concurrently -k -n nova,runtime -c blue,magenta "npm run dev:https --workspace @rocketcrab/nova" "npm run dev:https --workspace @rocketcrab/runtime"
scripts.test: node --test scripts/*.test.mjs && npm run test --workspaces --if-present && npm run test:edge
scripts.test:watch: concurrently -k -n nova,runtime -c blue,magenta "npm run test:watch --workspace @rocketcrab/nova" "npm run test:watch --workspace @rocketcrab/runtime"
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
